content: {"charges": [{"claim": "The regex for stripWWW incorrectly limits TLD length to 62 characters, causing valid hostnames with 63-character TLDs to not have www stripped.", "file": "index.js", "line": 208, "severity": "major", "witnessCode": "import { describe, it } from 'node:test';\\nimport { strict as assert } from 'node:assert/strict';\\nimport normalizeUrl from '../index.js';\\n\\ndescribe('normalizeUrl stripWWW with 63-character TLD', () => {\\n  it('should strip www for 63-character TLD in base but not in head', () => {\\n    const tld = 'a'.repeat(63);\\n    const url = `http://www.a.${tld}/path`;\\n    const options = { stripWWW: true };\\n\\n    const result = normalizeUrl(url, options);\\n    assert.strictEqual(result, `http://a.${tld}/path`);\\n  });\\n});"}]}
